prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='CWT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ARIMA, rf, catboost, and CWT_rf all achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), with ARIMA selected as trend champion. CWT_rf dominates seasonality capture (0.6405 correlation) and overall RMSE (459.88). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 9.33) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.29) suggest robust median/trimmed-mean combination over stacking.
